digest.component_or_area: review-bot container IAM / Bedrock access grant
propositions: The rebar-gerrit-instance-role grants only SSM read and KMS decrypt and lacks any Bedrock permission, blocking the review-bot from obtaining Bedrock-authorized credentials.
This story adds a new scoped inline Bedrock policy in iam_s7.tf attached to the existing role without modifying iam.tf, honoring the single-owner contract.
The granted policy is limited to bedrock:InvokeModel and InvokeModelWithResponseStream scoped to Claude foundation models and the cross-region inference profile, not bedrock:* on *.

There is contradictory evidence about whether containers can reach IMDS on this host, so AC1 empirically probes IMDSv2 reachability from inside the review-bot container to select the default IAM-only path.
If IMDS is unreachable, the contingency sets http_put_response_hop_limit to 2 while keeping http_tokens required and records the bounded-exposure exception in ADR 0046.

Verification uses AWS CLI/boto3 directly, confirming get-caller-identity returns the instance role, a Claude Converse call returns 200, a non-Claude model returns AccessDeniedException, and opcert/Gerrit remain healthy.
